record_type_quote: Experiment 1 was our first replication of Feiman and Snedeker’s (2016) Experiment 3.

targets.title: The logic in language: How all quantifiers are alike, but each quantifier is different.
targets.evidence_quote: Below, we first report a close replication experiment of Feiman and Snedeker’s (2016) Experiment 3 in Dutch.
targets.outcome_quote: Both Experiments 1 and 2 failed to replicate Feiman and Snedeker’s (2016) finding that priming of logical representations is not modulated by verb overlap in the prime-target pair: We did not observe robust logical representation priming between verbs and observed that priming is stronger if the verb is repeated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict across both experiments. Original-data power analysis informs sample size and is not a separate reproduction claim; prior within-verb data are comparators rather than independently retested targets.

reasoning: Title, authors and DOI match the complete 34-page article with references. Two new samples retest published Experiment 3. References used as contextual comparisons are not targets.
